note: Rewritten from entry 151 in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; alates are recorded as unknown in the source and only soldiers and workers are described; total length and the head width/length indices are omitted owing to OCR damage (4.5–15.9, 10.58–0.60); synonymy lists, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown to dark brown; antennae yellowish brown; mandibles dark reddish brown; body straw yellow. Head sparsely pilose, body moderately pilose. Head capsule elongate, rectangular, sides nearly parallel; length to mandibular base 1.6–1.9 mm, maximum width 1.0–1.13 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, third segment shortest, fourth longer than fifth. Labrum pentagonal, anterolateral angles strongly angulate, anterior margin slightly pointed medially, wider than long; length 0.15–0.25 mm, width 0.30–0.40 mm. Mandibles strongly curved, falcate, apex acute and incurved, length 0.95–1.15 mm, slightly more than half the head length, left mandible length/head length ratio 0.55–0.63, basal half of inner margin coarsely serrate. Postmentum rod-shaped, waist slightly constricted behind midlength; length 1.0–1.15 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.35 mm, waist width 0.18–0.20 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped; length 0.33–0.43 mm, width 0.65–0.73 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and antennae pale yellow; body paler than the head. Head moderately pilose, body densely pilose. Head capsule subquadrate; length to mandibular base 0.75–1.08 mm, maximum width 0.85–1.10 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented, third segment shortest, fourth longer than fifth. Postclypeus convex, pilose, length slightly more than half its width. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin with a distinct notch, posterior margin slightly concave; length 0.28–0.33 mm, width 0.50–0.60 mm.
